Manasvi is very encouraging and guides you well to not just understand the process but to also ensure you have a comfortable time in the studio. Overall it was a very lovely experience to have. :)

featured_reviews.name: Mayuri Kadam
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had an amazing time at the ceramic workshop with Manasvi. She was very friendly and I truly appreciate her kindness throughout the session.

Throughout the workshop, Mansavi demonstrated a deep understanding of ceramics and patiently guided me through each step. She shared valuable insights and techniques, which allowed me to gain a wealth of knowledge and improve my skills in such a short time. She encouraged us to explore our artistic instincts and gave us the freedom to experiment with different designs.

I am grateful for the opportunity to attend this workshop and meet such a wonderful instructor like Manasvi. I highly recommend her workshops to anyone interested in exploring the world of ceramics. Thank you, Manasvi, for an unforgettable experience!

featured_reviews.name: Kay
featured_reviews.review_text:
Had the most wonderful experience with Manasvi, she was very patient and shared just the right amount of information regarding the process of creating ceramic art. The workshop was fun and an excellent way to experiment with the form if you're interested.

Would 100% recommend working with her, I loved the process of the creating my bowl, and can't wait to see the glazed piece :)

featured_reviews.name: Swara Kalantre
featured_reviews.review_text: Attended a workshop on Ceramic sculpture by Manasvi at the Nature’s Canvas Studio. This place definitely lives up to its name. There’s all greenery around the place with lots of birds chirping and definitely the rainy weather. Manasvi is a great artist , a teacher , a mentor and an amazing person with whom I bonded so well. I would recommend this studio to anyone and everyone who thinks they are not artistic enough but needs a drive and vision to create something by pushing their limits to their potential.

featured_reviews.name: Charmi Vadhan
featured_reviews.review_text: I had attended this ceramic sculpture workshop and it was really fun and therapeutic experience. Really enjoyed doing the art work. Had been with my friends and manasvi was really sweet and co operative with us. Had a great time👍
